proof_body:
by
  intro n hn
  refine ⟨(Nat.primeFactorsList n : Multiset ℕ), ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · intro p hp
    exact Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactorsList (by simpa using hp)
  · simpa using Nat.prod_primeFactorsList hn
  · rintro s ⟨h1, h2⟩
    have h1' : ∀ p ∈ s.toList, Nat.Prime p := fun p hp => h1 p (Multiset.mem_toList.1 hp)
    have h2' : s.toList.prod = n := by rw [Multiset.prod_toList]; exact h2
    exact (Multiset.coe_toList s).symm.trans (Multiset.coe_eq_coe.2 (Nat.primeFactorsList_unique h2' h1'))
target_source: ∀ n : ℕ, n ≠ 0 → ∃! s : Multiset ℕ, (∀ p ∈ s, Nat.Prime p) ∧ s.prod = n
